description: This file initializes the database schema for a project involving user profiles, sessions, messages, and files with associated Row Level Security policies on a Supabase/PostgreSQL backend. It defines tables, indexes, constraints, security policies, and some functions/triggers for maintaining data integrity and security.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at
methods.description: Function to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp on row updates in the 'sessions' table.
